Stacy is described as having the loveliest fair, curly hair. She is also noted for having particularly fascinating eyes.

## History

Miss Stacy took over as Anne's new schoolteacher in October, quickly winning her affection and organizing a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a school flag. At the end of the term, she confirmed that she would return the following year to prepare her class for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. Throughout the following school year, she guided [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through intense preparations for those exams.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's schoolteacher and mentor, first arriving at Avonsea School while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is recovering from a broken ankle. Under her instruction starting in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flourishes academically, participating enthusiastically in Miss Stacy's school [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert and later studying intensely under her guidance for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII.
